think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL docs. 2) Check whether the numeric domain includes sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/unlimited) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such sentinel values exist, label it a special knob and record those values; otherwise, treat it as a regular numeric knob.
